name: Wexner Center for the Arts
watch: Epstein-linked name; artist and grant withdrawals in 2026.
why_flagged: Ohio State arts centre founded by Les Wexner's 1987 gift of $1M and 100,000 L Brands shares. It takes $3.3M a year in grants and gifts; FY2025 revenue about $13M.
records_note: It posts annual reports for 2019-20 to 2024-25 that list donors by tier and its foundation board; Form 990 filings for the foundation are public.
other_findings: Epstein link · Les Wexner · documented: The Ohio State arts centre is named for Les Wexner's father and was founded with a 1987 gift from Les Wexner. Wexner is mentioned more than 1,000 times in the Epstein files. Epstein managed Wexner's money from 1989 to 2007 and held power of attorney over his fortune; Wexner denies an FBI listing of him as a co-conspirator and Virginia Giuffre's allegation that she was trafficked to him. Ohio State has received about 500 renaming requests since Wexner's House Oversight deposition in February 2026 and says they are under review. The staff union Wex Workers United called for a new name in May 2026, and in June 2026 one artist and a grant pulled out over the name. The centre has not been renamed.

name: LACMA
why_flagged: Los Angeles County owns the Geffen Galleries, funded 80% by private gifts and 20% by the county. Donors include David Geffen, Elaine Wynn, the Keck Foundation and trustee Steve Tisch.
records_note: It posts audited financial statements for 2019 to 2025 and names campaign donors as of March 2025, and lists its board; no annual reports found.
other_findings: WikiLeaks, 2014-03 to 2014-07: Sony's lobbying chief briefed LACMA trustee Michael Lynton before a lunch with Supervisor Ridley-Thomas, covering LACMA's county-funding request and Sony's past support for his PAC. LACMA also asked Sony for about $900K of equipment. (Sony emails) | Epstein link · Steve Tisch · documented: Steve Tisch is a LACMA trustee and in 2011 helped fund its purchase of Marclay's The Clock. Emails from April and May 2013 in the DOJ files show Epstein offering to introduce him to women. Tisch says they had a "brief association" and emailed about adult women, movies, philanthropy and investments, that he never went to the island, and that he deeply regrets associating with Epstein.
